parameters.content:
## Public-page automation preflight

1. Subscribe to Automation Integration Preflight on RapidAPI.
2. In n8n, create a Header Auth credential with header name `x-rapidapi-key` and your RapidAPI application key.
3. Select that credential on **Build Acceptance Pack**.
4. Edit **Set Target and Objective**, then run the workflow.

The URL check blocks selected literal private hosts; it does not resolve DNS or inspect redirects. Only submit pages you may share with the service. The output keeps the evidence, launch gate, acceptance tests, and prioritized backlog together for implementation review.

API: https://rapidapi.com/tinyopsstudio/api/automation-integration-preflight
